But music can summon the dark as well as soothe the soul, and it's not long before Martyn is hitting more than just the keys on his synthesizer keyboard.

takintilar-2024.title: Takintilar
takintilar-2024.synopsis: The film, adapted from French writer Laurent Baffie’s play “Toc Toc,” revolves around the adventures of six individuals with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) whose appointments with renowned psychiatrist Orhan Kerim Baykal overlap, only to find that the doctor is nowhere to be found.

our-season-2023.title: Our Season
our-season-2023.synopsis: Bok-ja is granted a special vacation after her death, which allows her to go see her daughter, Jin-joo, a university professor living abroad. Unlike her expectation, Bok-ja finds Jin-joo living in her old house running a local diner and becomes frustrated with questions that she is unable to ask. After spending time alongside Jin-joo, Bok-ja realizes that her daughter is struggling with the unresolved feelings about her, and tries to find a way to show her sincere feelings that she had never shared before.

robinhood-2025.title: Robinhood

Whatever!

c-d-criminal-or-devil-2024.title: C.D

chalti-rahe-zindagi-2024.title: Chalti Rahe Zindagi
chalti-rahe-zindagi-2024.synopsis: Krishna Bhagat is a local bread supplier in three different families of a housing complex - it's the early times of the pandemic setting in. A lockdown is announced and that sets to change lives for these families poignantly. Phase 1 of lockdown exposes the extramarital affair of Arjun's wife with Aru's husband, a neighbor. In phase 2 Sushma, pressurised by her son Akash, a TV journalist, forces Krishna to return the money that she had loaned him. Phase 3 brings to fore the conflict within Leela Seth, a lady in her late sixties, her daughter in law, Naina in her mid thirties and granddaughter, a teenager, Siya. Will all of them be able to emerge out of their situations with a brave spirit?

iron-lung-2026.title: Iron Lung

welcome-home-2018.title: Welcome Home
welcome-home-2018.synopsis: A couple try to repair their damaged union in an Italian vacation paradise. Then they discover the owner's intentions.

guy-manley-super-spy-2024.title: Guy Manley: Super Spy
guy-manley-super-spy-2024.synopsis: Guy Manley, formerly the world’s most preeminent secret agent, who, while drowning in his alcohol-filled retirement, is brought back for one last mission by his former boss Buck Cash. His mission? Kill Buck's brother, Rich Cash, keeping him from being elected the city's new mayor, thereby stopping him from becoming the most powerful person in the world!

raw-2016.title: Raw
raw-2016.synopsis: Eddie Murphy delights, shocks and entertains with dead-on celebrity impersonations, observations on '80s love, sex and marriage, a remembrance of Mom's hamburgers and much more.

prom-night-2008.title: Prom Night
prom-night-2008.synopsis: Donna's senior prom is supposed to be the best night of her life, though a sadistic killer from her past has different plans for her and her friends.

every-day-2018.title: Every Day
every-day-2018.synopsis: 16-year old Rhiannon falls in love with a mysterious spirit named “A” that inhabits a different body every day. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and “A” work each day to find each other, not knowing what the next day will bring.

scarlet-diva-2000.title: Scarlet Diva
scarlet-diva-2000.synopsis: A young Italian actress embarks on a self-destructive spree of sex, drugs and other excess while doing some soul searching to find the path for redemption.

bone-face-2025.title: Bone Face
bone-face-2025.synopsis: When a masked killer slaughters several campers in a small town, a sheriff and a deputy track the murderer to a local diner where, using their investigative skills, they must discover which person in the diner is the actual killer.

miss-valentine-2024.title: Miss Valentine
miss-valentine-2024.synopsis: Samantha carries the baggage of having had an onstage meltdown after winning her hometown’s Miss Valentine pageant as a teen. Years later, she returns home following a painful breakup and finds that things are much different this time around.

the-red-virgin-2024.title: The Red Virgin
the-red-virgin-2024.synopsis: مقتبس عن قصة حقيقية. ببلوغها سنّ الـ16، كانت "هيلديغارت" قد أصبحت خبيرة في الشؤون الجنسية الأنثوية وصارت واحدة من أنجح العقول الشابّة في "إسبانيا" في ثلاثينيات القرن الـ20، وهذا بفضل جهود والدتها في صقلها لتصبح امرأة المستقبل المثالية. لكن حين تبدأ "هيلديغارت" في خوض غمار الحياة والتمرّد على تلك التوقعات الصارمة، تبذل والدتها كل ما بوسعها لمنعها من التحرّر.

v-h-s-beyond-2024.title: V/H/S/Beyond
v-h-s-beyond-2024.synopsis: The infinite playground of forbidden worlds and dangerous lifeforms offered by the sci-fi horror genre will lead to the biggest, maddest, bloodiest V/H/S ever.

the-seed-of-the-sacred-fig-2024.title: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
the-seed-of-the-sacred-fig-2024.titleEn: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
the-seed-of-the-sacred-fig-2024.originalTitle: The Seed of the Sacred Fig 2024
the-seed-of-the-sacred-fig-2024.synopsis: Investigating judge Iman grapples with paranoia amid political unrest in Tehran. When his gun vanishes, he suspects his wife and daughters, imposing draconian measures that strain family ties as societal rules crumble.

national-anthem-2023.title: National Anthem
national-anthem-2023.synopsis: A 21-year old construction worker in rural New Mexico joins a community of queer ranchers and rodeo performers in search of their own version of the American dream.

a-million-days-2023.title: A Million Days
a-million-days-2023.synopsis: On the eve of a historic lunar mission, astronaut Anderson uncovers a sinister artificial intelligence plot aimed at derailing the expedition. As tensions soar and trust unravels, Anderson races against time to unveil the true motives of the AI. With the fate of humanity at stake, he navigates a treacherous path to save the mission and secure the future against an imminent threat.

the-infallibles-2024.title: The Infallibles
the-infallibles-2024.synopsis: When a gang of robbers provokes chaos in Paris and humiliates the police, the Minister of the Interior wants new blood at the helm of the investigation: Alia is from Marseille, fiery-tempered and unmanageable, Hugo is Parisian, valedictorian and meticulous. In short, they have every reason to hate each other. A forced alliance, for better or for worse, or maybe blossoming into something else?

the-portable-door-2023.title: The Portable Door
the-portable-door-2023.synopsis: يتلقى بول كاربنتر وظيفة داخل شركة غامضة في لندن، وسرعان ما يكتشف وجود باب سحري متنقل، يساعده على الانتقال إلى أماكن بعيدة ومختلفة على الكوكب.

madu-2024.title: Madu
madu-2024.synopsis: From practicing barefoot on the streets of Lagos to performing on stage in England, twelve year old Anthony Madu leaves his home in Nigeria to study at one of the most prestigious ballet schools in the world. Anthony, who had barely left his neighborhood in Lagos, finds himself thrust into a new world where his wildest dream is suddenly within reach. His journey is a story of extraordinary obstacles, courage, growth, and ultimately, his search for belonging.

showing-up-2022.title: Showing Up
showing-up-2022.synopsis: يتناول العمل قصة نحاتة تستعد لتقديم معرض جديد لمنحوتاتها، وتحاول الموازنة بين عملها الفني الناجح، ومشاكل العائلة والأصدقاء التي تمر بها.

from-the-ashes-2024.title: From the Ashes
from-the-ashes-2024.synopsis: Milena, a young woman from Ukraine, who along with her mother and grandmother (and cat), desperately struggle to escape their war- torn home while an army of supporters on the opposite side of the world fight to keep them safe. Milena survived the destruction of Mariupol, cowering for a month in the basement of a bombed-out building, watching her home and history burn. She managed to contact Ken Pontac, long-time Facebook friend and father figure. Their conversations bolstered Milena's spirits while Ken listened with growing apprehension.

american-symphony.title: American Symphony
american-symphony.synopsis: في هذا الوثائقي الذي يروي تفاصيل تجارب شخصية، يحاول الفنان الموسيقي "جون باتيست" تأليف سيمفونية بينما تخضع زوجته الكاتبة "سليكا جواد" لعلاج للسرطان.

bottoms.title: Bottoms
bottoms.synopsis: يدور العمل حول فتاتين في مدرسة ثانوية كبيرة، ورحلتهما عبر سلسلة من الأحداث الفوضوية قبل تخرجهما.

boukensha-ni-naritai-to-miyako-ni-deteit.title: 冒険者になりたいと都に出て行った娘がSランクになってた
boukensha-ni-naritai-to-miyako-ni-deteit.titleEn: 冒険者になりたいと都に出て行った娘がSランクになってた
boukensha-ni-naritai-to-miyako-ni-deteit.originalTitle: Boukensha ni Naritai to Miyako ni Deteitta Musume ga S-Rank ni Natteta

everything-everywhere-all-at-once.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
everything-everywhere-all-at-once.titleEn: كل شيء في كل مكان في وقت واحد
everything-everywhere-all-at-once.synopsis: تتورط مهاجرة صينية مسنة في مغامرة مجنونة، حينما تكتشف أنها وحدها من يستطيع إنقاذ العالم من خلال اكتشاف العوالم الأخرى الموازية لعالمها.

gran-turismo.title: Gran Turismo
gran-turismo.synopsis: استنادا إلى القصة الحقيقية لحلم مستحيل.  قصة تحقيق الأمنيات النهائية للاعب غران توريزمو المراهق الذي أكسبته مهاراته في الألعاب سلسلة من مسابقات نيسان ليصبح سائق سيارات سباق محترف فعلي.

loot.title: Loot
loot.synopsis: بعد الطلاق من زوجها بعد زواج دام 20 عاماً، يجب أن تكتشف "مولي نوفاك" ما ستفعله بالتسوية التي تبلغ 87 مليار دولار. تقرر إعادة التواصل مع مؤسستها الخيرية والعالم الحقيقي، لتكتشف نفسها على طول الطريق.

ololade.title: Olóládé
ololade.synopsis: يصبح صديقان فجأة ثريين بطرق لم تخطر على البال، ويبدو أنّ الأمر مثالي لدرجة مثيرة للشك... إلى أن يتورطا في مخطط غسيل أموال مهلك.

platonic.title: Platonic
platonic.synopsis: يؤدي "سيث روغن" و"روز بيرن" دوري شخصين في أواسط عمريهما كانت تجمعهما صداقة حميمة أفلاطونية بعد شرخ طويل في علاقتهما، ثم تصير صداقتهما أشد استحواذاً على حياتيهما، مزعزعة استقرارهما بطريقة مضحكة للغاية.

ripd-2-rise-of-the-damned.title: R.I.P.D. 2: Rise of the Damned
ripd-2-rise-of-the-damned.synopsis: عندما يجد الشريف روي بولسيفر نفسه في الحياة الآخرة، ينضم إلى قوة شرطة خاصة ويعود إلى الأرض لإنقاذ البشرية من الموتى الأحياء.

romantic-getaway.title: Romantic Getaway
romantic-getaway.synopsis: يسعى كل من أليسون وديكون بشدة لإنجاب طفل، ولكن لم يتبقى لديهما المال للقيام بالمزيد من علاجات التلقيح الصناعي، لذلك يقررا سرقة المال من رئيسهما المراوغ.

the-dads.title: The Dads
the-dads.synopsis: في رحلة للصيد مع والد "ماثيو شيبارد"، يناقش خمسة آباء مختلفين حبهم وآمالهم ومخاوفهم نحو أبنائهم المتحولين جندريًا في هذا الوثائقي القصير.

the-man-who-fell-to-earth.title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
the-man-who-fell-to-earth.titleEn: The Man Who Fell to Earth
the-man-who-fell-to-earth.originalTitle: The Man Who Fell to Earth
the-man-who-fell-to-earth.synopsis: يصل كائن فضائي خارج كوكب الأرض إلى الأرض عند نقطة تحول في التطور البشري ويجب أن يواجه ماضيه لتحديد مستقبلنا.

war.title: War
war.synopsis: بعد مقتل صديقه وزميله بالعمل على يد مجرم معدوم الضمير، يعتزم المحقق الفيدرالي (جون كروفورد) الإنتقام لصديقه، وذلك عبر التقرب للعصابات الأسيوية من أجل الوصول للسفاح، مما يؤدي لظهور العديد من المفاجأت.

world-war-ii-with-tom-hanks.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
world-war-ii-with-tom-hanks.titleEn: World War II with Tom Hanks
world-war-ii-with-tom-hanks.originalTitle: World War II with Tom Hanks

you-hurt-my-feelings.title: You Hurt My Feelings
you-hurt-my-feelings.synopsis: ‫في إطار كوميدي درامي، تنهار الحياة الزوجية لكاتبة روائية، حينما تتنصت على زوجها وتكتشف رأيه الحقيقي في كتابها الأخير.
